Subject: Request: 3yr retention price cap + auto-negotiation opt‑out — Horizon Health

Team —

Quick background: Horizon Health (large regional healthcare SaaS) has verbally committed to a 3‑year, $2.4M committed spend (net of discounts) to standardize on Redwood for inference across several product lines. They asked for two non‑standard commercial items we don't typically grant without exec signoff:

- Retention price cap: a contractual guarantee that list adjusted per‑unit price (token-based blended rate) will not increase by more than 8% year‑over‑year for the three‑year term.
- Auto‑negotiation opt‑out: language preventing automatic renewal price renegotiation by us at renewal (they want the option to renew on the same capped terms or walk).

They also requested a small termination window (30 days) in year 2 if material product regressions occur. Sales is willing to concede the cap and opt‑out if we can limit downside with a short market‑adjustment carve (see below). This comes with planned upsell motion and Dedicated capacity onboarding in Q1, so retention value is high.

Key commercials attached (Horizon_HR_Commercial_Term_Summary_v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW. Summary: $2.4M commit, year 1 effective blended price $0.0018/token (after 36% discount), year 2 proposed capped uplift <=8%, year 3 capped uplift <=8%.

Request: Exec approval to offer the cap + opt‑out conditional on:
1) a market‑adjustment clause limited to extraordinary increases in GPU/TCO >15% with pass‑through capped at 3% per year;
2) acceptance of a modest platform‑level SLA carve (we keep right to degrade non‑core features during major incidents);
3) require a signed SOW + revenue recognition schedule within 30 days.

Why approve: retention value high, low churn risk for healthcare vertical, potential for Dedicated expansion (predictable capacity, >$600k incremental ACV in yr2 if performance stable).

Risks: precedent — this would set an explicit multi‑year cap precedent for other large accounts. We can gate approval behind legal language and Deal Desk guardrails.

Please advise appetite. If we get a greenlight, Jordan/Legal to finalize redlines and I will share revised doc with Horizon for signature.

Attachments: Horizon_HR_Commercial_Term_Summary_v2.xlsx, DRAFT_SOW-Horizon-3yr.pdf

Thanks —
Marcus
